We will change partners after twenty minutes so everyone can meet someone new. There are topic cards if you don't know what to talk about.

question_pool_passages.title: A trial music lesson

We can lend you a guitar for that lesson, so don't buy one yet. If you decide to continue, lessons are fifteen pounds each. Most students practise a little every day rather than once for a long time. You said you work late, so perhaps ten minutes before breakfast would fit your routine.

question_pool_passages.title: A shorter walking tour

We will still see the castle and market square, but not the bridge. The walk should finish at eleven thirty instead of twelve. question_pool_passages.title: An online cooking class

I sent a link this morning; please use that one, not last week's link. You only need rice, two eggs and some vegetables. We won't cook chicken today because it takes longer. Keep your camera on if you want me to see your work and help you.

question_pool_passages.title: A new work rota

Please let me know by tomorrow morning so I can finish the rota.

question_pool_passages.title: A delayed dinner order

question_pool_passages.title: Sharing kitchen jobs

question_pool_passages.title: A village cinema evening

question_pool_passages.title: A phone left on a bus

question_pool_passages.title: Choosing a birthday gift together

Thank you.

question_pool_passages.title: A cafe job interview
question_pool_passages.transcript: Hi Aisha. Thanks for applying for the Saturday job. Could you come for a short interview on Thursday at four? question_pool_passages.title: Keeping a library book longer

question_pool_passages.title: A washing machine repair visit

If a new part is needed, the worker will explain the extra price before fitting it. You can then decide whether to continue.

question_pool_passages.title: A last-minute room change

question_pool_passages.title: A rainy holiday plan

I've only checked the details, not booked it. Shall we go there, or wait until the afternoon to see if the rain stops?

question_pool_passages.title: A late hotel arrival
question_pool_passages.transcript: Good afternoon, Mrs King. Your room will be ready at three, although you can leave your bags with us from twelve. You asked about a late arrival tonight. question_pool_passages.title: Moving a birthday meal

question_pool_passages.title: Returning a pair of shoes

question_pool_passages.title: A rescheduled neighbourhood clean-up
question_pool_passages.text: The neighbourhood clean-up has been postponed because Saturday's weather is expected to be very wet. We will meet on Sunday at ten instead of Saturday at nine. question_pool_passages.title: Returning an online order
question_pool_passages.text: If your jacket does not fit, send it back within fourteen days of delivery. Keep the labels attached and include your order number. You may also exchange it for another size, but please contact us first to check that the size is in stock.

question_pool_passages.title: Study rooms at the library
question_pool_passages.text: Two small study rooms can be booked online. Each room holds up to four people. Bookings last one hour, but you can ask at the desk for more time if nobody is waiting. A room marked 'reserved' is being kept for someone who has already booked it; please do not enter it without checking. If you arrive more than ten minutes late, your booking may be given to another group. Food is not allowed, but covered drinks are fine.

question_pool_passages.title: Review of a budget hotel
question_pool_passages.text: We chose Hill View Hotel because it was cheaper than the hotels in the centre. Our room was small but clean, and the staff gave us useful bus advice. The bus stop was nearby, only a two-minute walk from the front door. Breakfast was simple and cost extra, so we sometimes ate at a cafe. I would stay here again for a short trip, but not if I needed a large room for a long family holiday.

question_pool_passages.title: A shared office desk
question_pool_passages.text: From Monday, the small office will have shared desks rather than a desk for each person. Choose any empty desk when you arrive, then clear it before you leave. Personal items can go in the cupboard beside the door. If you need the same desk for a video meeting, book it on the office calendar. This change will make room for two new workers without renting another office. Please tell the manager if you need help moving your things.

question_pool_passages.title: An evening course booking
question_pool_passages.text: The photography course costs sixty pounds for six evening lessons. Use of a camera is included, so beginners do not need to buy one before joining. The price does not cover printing photographs; you can choose whether to pay for that later. Classes are on Wednesdays, but the first meeting is on Tuesday because the teacher is away on the first Wednesday. Please bring a notebook to the first meeting.

question_pool_passages.title: Working hours for students
question_pool_passages.text: Our cafe needs a student helper for twelve hours a week. Working times are flexible: you can choose from morning or afternoon shifts to fit your college timetable. Please do not bring an application during the lunch rush, when staff have little time to talk.

question_pool_passages.title: A nearly full cycling tour
question_pool_passages.text: Only two places remain on Sunday's cycling tour. The morning group is full, so new bookings are for the afternoon ride at two. Bikes and helmets are provided. The route is mostly flat, but you should be able to ride for an hour without stopping often. If you are unsure, try our short practice session on Saturday. It is free for people who have booked the tour. Please book the practice session separately.

question_pool_passages.title: Choosing a new flatmate
question_pool_passages.text: We are looking for a flatmate from September. The room is small, but it has a desk and a large window. Rent is lower than for the other bedroom because it faces the busy road. We both work early shifts, so we prefer quiet evenings at home. A person who enjoys late parties may not find this flat suitable. If you like a calm home and do not mind some traffic noise, please contact us.

question_pool_passages.title: A review of a local bus service
question_pool_passages.text: I use the number seven bus to reach college. Last year it was often late, but it has become more reliable: it now arrives at about the same time each morning. The new buses have comfortable seats, although the ride is still crowded after four. I would recommend it for morning travel. In the afternoon, allow extra time because you may have to wait for a bus with room.

question_pool_passages.title: Safety on a hot day
question_pool_passages.text: Saturday's charity walk will go ahead, but the weather will be hotter than expected. Start early to avoid the strongest sun in the middle of the day. Bring water; there are refill points at the park gate and the sports hall. The long route takes three hours, while the short one takes about one. You can change to the short route at the first sign. The aim is to enjoy helping, not to finish the longest distance.

question_pool_passages.title: A restaurant booking message
question_pool_passages.text: Dear Ms Ford, your table for five is confirmed for Saturday at seven. Please call if the number of guests changes. If you need to cancel, tell us before Friday evening so we can offer the table to someone else. You do not need to pay a deposit for this booking. Please note that we keep tables for fifteen minutes after the booked time unless you phone to say you are running late.

question_pool_passages.title: Packing for an overnight trip
question_pool_passages.text: For the overnight school visit, pack light clothes, a warm top and comfortable shoes. A towel and bedding are supplied at the hostel, so leave those at home. Bring a spare T-shirt: an extra clean one may be useful after the outdoor games. You may bring a little spending money, but all meals and entry tickets are paid for. Put any medicine in a named bag and give it to your teacher before departure.

question_pool_passages.title: A weekend market ticket
question_pool_passages.text: The food market is open to everyone on Sunday from ten. Ordinary tickets cost four pounds and are sold at the gate. Bring your own shopping bag. Some sellers accept only cash, although card payment is possible at the main ticket gate.

question_pool_passages.title: A price reduction at the pool
question_pool_passages.text: From next month, the swimming pool offers reduced prices on weekday mornings. An adult swim will cost three pounds instead of five between nine and twelve. The usual price applies after twelve and at weekends. This offer is for individual visits, not swimming lessons. You do not need to be a member. The manager hopes quieter mornings will become busier, leaving more space in the evenings for people who work during the day.

question_pool_passages.title: A temporary classroom
question_pool_passages.text: Our evening art group will use the church hall for the next three weeks while the college roof is repaired. This is a temporary change; we will return to the college afterwards. The church hall is opposite the library and has no sinks for washing brushes, so bring a bottle of water and a small container. The starting time is still six. Please leave the tables clean because another group uses the hall the following morning.

question_pool_passages.title: A review of a repair shop
question_pool_passages.text: My laptop stopped working two days before an online exam. I took it to Quick Fix, where the staff explained the problem in words I could understand. They could not finish it that day, but they lent me a basic laptop for the exam. The repair cost a little more than I expected, yet I found the service very helpful. I would use them again when I need advice, not just the lowest price.

question_pool_passages.title: Booking a ferry ticket
question_pool_passages.text: Passengers taking a car must book a space in advance, before the day of travel. Foot passengers can usually buy tickets at the port, but summer sailings are busy. Car drivers should arrive forty minutes before departure; people without cars need twenty minutes. Tickets can be moved to another sailing if space is available, but there is no refund for missing a boat. Please check the departure port carefully because this company uses two nearby ports.

question_pool_passages.title: An optional museum activity
question_pool_passages.text: The class visit includes entry to the museum and a guided tour. Afterwards there is an optional drawing workshop: you may join it or spend that time looking around on your own. The workshop costs two pounds extra, paid at the desk. Everyone must meet at the main entrance at three, whether they join the workshop or not. Bring lunch, since there will not be enough time to queue at the cafe before the tour.

question_pool_passages.title: A reminder about a rented room
question_pool_passages.text: Dear Mr Ross, this is a reminder that your room booking ends at noon on Friday. Please leave the key at reception before you go. You asked about staying until four; unfortunately another guest arrives at two, so this is not possible. We can keep your luggage free of charge until six. There is a quiet seating area near reception if you need to wait for your train. Thank you for staying with us.

question_pool_passages.title: An online booking fee
question_pool_passages.text: I booked a concert ticket online for twenty pounds. At the payment page I saw a two-pound booking charge, so the total was twenty-two. The charge was an extra fee for using the booking service. The ticket office sells the same ticket for twenty pounds without the fee, but it closes before I finish work. I decided to pay online because getting to the office would also cost money and take time.

question_pool_passages.title: A crowded train journey
question_pool_passages.text: I usually take the six o'clock train home, but yesterday I left work early and caught the five o'clock train. It was crowded, with people standing along the whole carriage, so I could not find a seat. The journey was only twenty minutes, yet it felt longer. Next time I would rather wait for my usual train and spend the extra time reading at the station. Arriving home a little earlier was not worth the uncomfortable ride.

question_pool_passages.title: A disappointing cooking kit
question_pool_passages.text: I ordered a kit to make vegetable soup. The recipe was easy to follow, and the ingredients were fresh. The company returned the delivery fee, which was fair, but next time I will buy ingredients locally when I need them for a particular day.

question_pool_passages.title: Picking up a theatre ticket

question_pool_passages.title: A change to a school lunch menu

question_pool_passages.title: Replacing a damaged library card
question_pool_passages.text: If your library card is damaged, bring it to the main desk. We can replace it with a new one while keeping the same account and book loans. question_pool_passages.title: Joining a local history project
question_pool_passages.text: Our town history project needs people to take part. You can join in by recording a short memory of the high street or lending an old photograph for us to copy. Contact us before bringing valuable items, so we can arrange a safe place to keep them.

question_pool_passages.title: A useful second-hand desk
question_pool_passages.text: I bought a second-hand desk from a neighbour. It had a few marks on top, but the drawers opened smoothly and it was strong enough for my computer. A new desk would have cost three times as much. I spent an afternoon cleaning it and painting the top. Now it looks good in my small room. For me it was a bargain: I got something useful for a very good price, although it took some work.

question_pool_passages.title: Borrowing a neighbour's car
